about: Headline numbers from the post 'One run, no answer key' (26 Oct 2026). Solvers at low effort. AUROC is computed only within each benchmark (real tasks) or within each generator family (generated tasks). JEV = jev-1.13.0 reading one finished run with the completed_grade question in trace_variance_analyzer/jev.py; judge = gpt-6-sol at low effort with the prompt in trace_variance_analyzer/judge.py.

disagreement_precision.about: Share of pairs with at least one wrong run, split by the judge's call.

breaking_the_tie.about: AUROC for 'does this pair contain a wrong run?'. JEV reads only run A. Whole benchmarks held out.

signals_flip.about: Claude Opus 5.5, AUROC for 'did this run fail?': real benchmarks (within benchmark; trained rows out of fold with whole benchmarks held out) vs new generated tasks (within generator).

rows.signal: JEV, one read, no answer key

generated_test_bed.about: Synthetic causal-inference tasks with a planted effect (16,384 rows each); two confounding families plus randomized controls. GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra at high effort solved all 32 hard tasks blind.
